name: Seven Steps To Limbo
source:
[i]Welcome to Limbo . . . now play well or go to hell.[/i]

You're dead, Player. 

Welcome to Limbo, the grooviest jazz bar to ever grace the pits of purgatory. But don't think you have it easy -- you still gotta play good sh*t down here. Wrangle your bandmates and get your sh*t in order, or else we're sending you . . . downstairs.

[From [url=https://lemonpoppyseedgames.itch.io/seven-steps-to-limbo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]欢迎来到地狱边境。。。现在玩得好，否则就下地狱。[/i]

你死定了，玩家。

欢迎来到Limbo，这是有史以来最美妙的爵士酒吧，为炼狱的深渊增光添彩。但不要以为你过得很轻松——你仍然必须在这里打得很好。和你的乐队成员争吵，让你的事情井井有条，否则我们就派你去。。。楼下。

[来自[url=https://lemonpoppyseedgames.itch.io/seven-steps-to-limbo]itch.io[/url]]
